dict.string: CTRL listens while you hold Option so it can understand your command.
CTRL transcribes your voice on-device to understand your command.
CTRL opens websites in new browser windows so it can place them side by side.
CTRL connects your Bluetooth devices by voice and shows their battery in the notch.
macOS only shares the Wi-Fi network name with apps that have Location access. CTRL uses it to show which network you joined.
